30149.d: Wyverns (sometimes referred to as Living Wyverns to distinguish them from their skeletal counterparts) are dragon-like monsters in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon and the Ice Plateau.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
;For the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon:
# First enter to the first level of the dungeon.
#* Using the Port Sarim lodestone, go south, and then climb down the trapdoor.
#* Teleport to fairy ring AIQ to Mudskipper Point, go north, and then climb down the trapdoor.
#* Teleport with the hoardstalker ring or Dungeoneering cape (0,8).
# Head to the "skeletal wyverns" area (marked on the in-game map).
#* Head south of the dungeon to the crumbling wall and squeeze through it (requires 72 Agility).
#* Head to the south of the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon mine to enter the cave.
# Go to the south-west corner and descend down the rope.

;For the Frozen Waste Plateau in the Wilderness:
Use the Wilderness obelisks to teleport to the obelisk on the level 44 Wilderness and then run northwest. If the hard Wilderness achievements have been completed, the level 44 Wilderness obelisk can be directly selected. Otherwise it may take multiple attempts to arrive at the correct obelisk. The tradeable single-use item obelisk shard or its untradeable infinite charge version portable obelisk can be used to access the obelisks.
